skill.name: product-strategist
skill.description: Strategic product leadership toolkit for OKR cascades, market analysis, vision planning, and team alignment.
skill.summary: Create product OKR cascades and alignment plans for strategic product teams.
skill.author: davila7

content.user_title: Align Product Strategy With OKR Cascades
content.value_statement: Product leaders need clear goal alignment across company, product, and team levels. This skill creates OKR cascades, alignment scores, and strategy prompts for practical planning.
actual_capabilities: Generates company, product, and team OKR cascades from predefined strategy templates.
Supports growth, retention, revenue, innovation, and operational strategy modes.
Creates a readable OKR dashboard with company, product, team, and alignment sections.
Calculates vertical alignment, horizontal alignment, coverage, balance, and overall scores.
Translates objectives and key results into product and team contexts.
Can print structured OKR output when the script is run with the JSON option.
limitations: Uses predefined templates and sample metrics unless the user edits the script inputs.
Does not connect to OKR platforms, analytics tools, or project management systems.
Market analysis and vision planning are guidance workflows, not automated research.
Does not verify whether business targets are realistic or data-backed.

use_cases.title: Plan Quarterly Product OKRs
use_cases.description: Create aligned company, product, and team OKRs before quarterly planning starts.

use_cases.title: Translate Strategy Into Team Goals
use_cases.description: Map strategic objectives into team-level goals and identify alignment gaps.

use_cases.title: Prepare Investor Strategy Updates
use_cases.description: Turn growth, retention, or revenue strategy into a concise planning narrative.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Basic OKRs
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a growth OKR cascade for a product team using the skill defaults.

prompt_templates.title: Review Alignment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this OKR cascade and identify weak alignment between company, product, and team goals.

prompt_templates.title: Customize Strategy Mode
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a retention-focused OKR cascade for a SaaS product with current churn, NPS, and activation metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Build Executive Narrative
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this OKR cascade into an executive strategy memo with risks, tradeoffs, and team ownership.

output_examples.input: A product leader requests a growth OKR cascade for quarterly planning.
output_examples.output: The skill produces company objectives, product objectives, team objectives, owners, key results, and an alignment score summary.

output_examples.input: A product operations lead asks for alignment risks in an existing cascade.
output_examples.output: The skill highlights unsupported objectives, uneven team coverage, and suggested changes to improve vertical alignment.

output_examples.input: A founder asks for a revenue strategy planning memo.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes revenue goals, product-led initiatives, key metrics, team ownership, and planning risks.

best_practices: Provide current metrics, target metrics, strategy mode, and team names before generating OKRs.
Review generated targets with finance, sales, and engineering before committing them.
Use alignment scores as a planning signal, not as a final decision metric.
anti_patterns: Do not treat template-generated OKRs as validated business commitments.
Do not use the default sample metrics for real planning decisions.
Do not skip ownership review when translating goals to team-level OKRs.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create OKR cascades, strategy prompts, alignment dashboards, and product planning summaries.

faq.question: Which strategy modes are supported?
faq.answer: The included script supports growth, retention, revenue, innovation, and operational strategy modes.

faq.question: Can it use my real metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide metrics in your prompt, or edit the script inputs before running the generator.

faq.question: Does it perform live market research?
faq.answer: No. It can structure market analysis, but it does not fetch or verify external market data.

faq.question: Does it integrate with planning tools?
faq.answer: No. It produces text and optional structured output, but it does not sync with external tools.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is useful for product leaders, product operations teams, founders, and strategy teams.
